slides.h: Unauza vifaa vya gym? Wateja wako tayari wako app moja.
slides.en: Sell gym gear or supplements? Your buyers are already in one app.
List products with photos and categories, from your phone.
Buyers are FitFlex members already training. Your shop sits next to their pass.

slides.h: Oda zinakuja kwenye app, si kwenye DM.
slides.en: Orders arrive in the app with a notification. Confirm, prepare, deliver.
Vendors are verified before they sell. Members see who is verified before they buy.
